metadata.case_name: LAU CHIU WAH v. KWONG KEY CONSTRUCTION AND ENGINEERING LTD. AND OTHERS

injuries.description: the injury sustained in July 1995 by the plaintiff was a soft tissue contusion injury to the lower back.
source: the injury sustained in July 1995 by the plaintiff was a soft tissue contusion injury to the lower back.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injury of muscle, fascia or tendon of abdomen, lower back or pelvis

injuries.description: the plaintiff had degenerative changes in the lumbar spine which were likely to be present before the accident in July 1995.
source: the plaintiff had degenerative changes in the lumbar spine which were likely to be present before the accident in July 1995.
injuries.icd_description: Injuries to the abdomen, lower back, lumbar spine or pelvis

injuries.description: the plaintiff had suffered a back injury in 1989, whereby he suffered back pain but without any pain radiating to his lower extremities.
source: the plaintiff had suffered a back injury in 1989, whereby he suffered back pain but without any pain radiating to his lower extremities.
injuries.icd_description: Strain or sprain of muscle, fascia or tendon of lower back

manifestations.description: pain radiating down to the left lower limb
weakness of his left big toe
some limitation as to the range of movement of the plaintiff's back
could manage to sit for only 50 to 60 minutes
back pain when he sneezed or coughed
back pain with prolonged walking, prolonged standing, climbing stairs or lifting heavy weights
more back pain in the mornings

treatments_received: Accident and Emergency Department treatment at Princess Margaret Hospital
referral to and attendance at South Kwai Chung Specialist Clinic
consultations with private doctor Dr Ma Ming Shing in 1999

losses.description: Pain, suffering and loss of amenities resulting from the plaintiff's lower back injury.
Unable to return to his pre-accident job as a caisson worker.
